item.title: Spokesperson: Strait remains open to non-hostile commercial shipping; Iran ready for talks on maritime security
item.description: The foreign ministry spokesperson said the Strait of Hormuz remains open to all non-hostile commercial shipping and that Tehran is ready for talks on maritime security with regional states.

item.title: Air defences intercept drones over the Eastern Province
item.description: Saudi air defences intercepted and destroyed three drones launched by the Houthi militia towards the Eastern Province early on Wednesday, the Ministry of Defense said.
